title: Nauru’s Climate-Funded “Golden Passport” Scheme

blocks.content: Nauru launched the Nauru Economic and Climate Resilience Citizenship Program (ECRCP) on 1 January 2025 as a citizenship-by-investment scheme linked to climate adaptation finance. The programme offers Nauruan citizenship and a passport in return for a financial contribution, and it is connected to relocation and infrastructure plans for the island state.

items: Nauru is a small island country in the Pacific Ocean and is one of the world’s smallest sovereign states by area and population.
Citizenship-by-investment is also called a “golden passport” scheme in many countries.
Electronic Travel Authorization is a pre-travel screening system used by some countries for visa-exempt travellers.
Land ownership restrictions in Nauru remain linked to native Nauruan status under domestic rules.
